report_identity.report_title: China Taiping Insurance Holdings Company Limited 2025 Annual Report

business_overview.one_sentence: China Taiping is a Hong Kong-listed insurance holding company operating life insurance, property and casualty insurance, pension, reinsurance, asset management and related financial services.

segments.name: Life insurance
segments.business_substance: Life, pension and related insurance business mainly through subsidiaries including TPL and TPP.
segments.source: 2025 Annual Report management review and segment descriptions

segments.name: Property and casualty insurance
segments.business_substance: Motor, non-motor and overseas P&C insurance operations.
segments.source: 2025 Annual Report management review and segment descriptions

segments.name: Reinsurance
segments.business_substance: Reinsurance operations through TPRe and TPRe China.
segments.source: 2025 Annual Report management review and segment descriptions

segments.name: Asset management
segments.business_substance: Management of insurance funds and third-party assets.
segments.source: 2025 Annual Report management review, asset management business

business_overview.revenue_model: Insurance service results plus investment spread and returns from insurance fund assets; investment and insurance contract finance movements are core to profit.
business_notes: Financial and insurance funds are subject to insurance liabilities, investment contract liabilities and solvency capital requirements.
The Group's key business operations are conducted through regulated insurance subsidiaries.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Ordinary-company cash conversion is not applicable to an insurance group. Operating cash flow is dominated by insurance contract liabilities, investment contract liabilities and financial asset allocation. Owner earnback analysis uses 3-year median parent net profit with a 0.55 profit haircut.

evidence.note: Facts JSON stores annual report units; owner earnback metrics use absolute HKD.

evidence.value: TPL core 143%, TPI core 170%, TPP core 160%; comprehensive 230%, 236%, 215%
evidence.note: Insurance subsidiaries are regulated and subject to solvency requirements.

gaps: No exchange-provided market capitalization was refreshed during this run.
Annual report does not provide a full excess regulatory capital bridge distributable to the listed holding company.
Maintenance capital expenditure and working capital reinvestment are not meaningful under a normal-company formula for this insurance group.
